content: स्पष्ट {%a.%} [स्पश्-क्त नि˚ इडभावः] .²1 Distinctly visible, evident, clearly perceived, clear, plain, manifest; स्थष्टे जाते प्रत्यूषे <ls>K.</ls> ‘when it was broad day-break’; स्पष्टाकृतिः <ls>R. 18. 30</ls>; स्पष्टार्थः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Real, true. .²3 Full-blown. expanded. .²4 One who sees clearly. .{@-ष्टम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Clearly, distinctly, plainly. .²2 Openly, boldly. (स्पष्टीकृ means ‘to make clear or distinct’, explain, elucidate.)
